llm_raw_reply: On about ₹4,50,000 a year of spending, SBI Landmark Reward SELECT comes out on top. It should save you around ₹37,981 a year after fees. Note: SBI Landmark Reward SELECT is invite-only, so you can't apply for it directly. One caution: the card's own terms put its milestone benefit at much less than the ₹30,000 the ranking counts, so the real saving is likely lower.
